entities.title: Apply a migration to production
entities.summary: Apply a game's new migration files by hand, before its pull request is merged.
entities.when: A pull request adds a file to a game's worker/migrations/, and the owner has asked for it to go live.
steps: In the game's folder, check that npx wrangler whoami names the repository's account; otherwise stop and ask the owner
Record a restore point: npx wrangler d1 time-travel info <database>, and copy the bookmark into a comment on the pull request
Apply each new migration file once, in filename order: npx wrangler d1 execute <database> --remote -y --file worker/migrations/<file>
Look at a table the migration changed
Add the acknowledgement line to the pull request's description
entities.verify: The Database migration check passes on the pull request.

entities.title: The deploy stopped at the migration gate
entities.summary: A merge brought a database change nobody acknowledged, so nothing was deployed.
entities.when: The migrations job of a Deploy run failed.
steps: Apply the migration as in Apply a migration to production
Add the acknowledgement to the merged pull request's description
Re-run the failed jobs: gh run rerun <run id> --failed
entities.verify: The Deploy run's migrations job passes and the games deploy.

entities.title: A database change reached main without a pull request
entities.summary: No pull request carries an acknowledgement, so the gate can only be passed by hand.
entities.when: The gate reports a commit that no pull request brought.
steps: Deploy by hand with the acknowledgement: gh workflow run deploy.yml --ref main -f migration_applied=true
entities.verify: The Deploy run passes the gate.

entities.title: A migration broke production
entities.summary: Restoring the bookmark undoes every write since it, so only the owner decides on it.
entities.when: A game misbehaves after its migration was applied.
steps: If the owner decides to restore: npx wrangler d1 time-travel restore <database> --bookmark=<bookmark>, in the game's folder
entities.verify: The game works against the restored database.
